verdict.rationale: The service page names lawyers, notaries and solicitors as a distinct user class authenticating with their professional-order certificate. It also states that the generated pact must be digitally signed by all partners, which implies those signatures stay personal. Interveners must separately authorize data sharing, and SCAP lets people sign in the capacity of their company role. Missing for 10: published authorization/mandate forms, an explicit statement of what a professional intermediary may and may not do on the client's behalf, and an explicit list of which acts or signatures cannot be delegated.
